scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace @eubp/api & npm run dev --workspace @eubp/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @eubp/rules && npm run build --workspace @eubp/shared
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @eubp/api && npm run build --workspace @eubp/web
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @eubp/rules && node scripts/verify-v2.cjs && npm run test:api
scripts.test:api: npm run build --workspace @eubp/api && node --test test/unit/*.test.cjs scripts/security/*.test.cjs
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @eubp/api && node scripts/test-integration.cjs
